tasks.CalculateNumberofCats: Based on the ratio of cats to dogs (2 cats for every dog), this task calculates the number of cats.
tasks.CalculateNumberofRabbits: Using the information that the number of rabbits pets is twelve less than the combined number of pet dogs and cats, this task calculates the number of rabbits.
tasks.TotalPetsCalculation: This task sums up the total number of pets in the neighborhood.
